name: radio-group-fieldset
title: Radio Group: Fieldset
description: Use `FieldSet` and `FieldLegend` to group radio items with a label and description.

files.content:
import {
  FieldDescription,
  FieldItem,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSet,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/field";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/radio-group";

export const RadioGroupFieldset = () => (
  <FieldSet className="w-full max-w-xs">
    <FieldLegend variant="label">Subscription Plan</FieldLegend>
    <FieldDescription>Yearly and lifetime plans offer significant savings.</FieldDescription>
    <RadioGroup defaultValue="monthly">
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="monthly" />
        <FieldLabel className="font-normal">Monthly ($9.99/month)</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="yearly" />
        <FieldLabel className="font-normal">Yearly ($99.99/year)</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="lifetime" />
        <FieldLabel className="font-normal">Lifetime ($299.99)</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
    </RadioGroup>
  </FieldSet>
);
